I did NOT fill the cents in from arithmetic, though note that Line 4 is 49,961.00 and Line 5 is clearly 58,577.50, which would put Line 3 at .50. The rest of the page is legible. The form's own arithmetic is off by $0.50 at the bottom: 58,577.50 - 50,279.59 = 8,297.91, but Line 7 prints 8,297.41 (Line 6's superscript looks like '51' where Line 2 reads '.59' — another overwrite).
